news.title: Fourth quarter dividend of ₹2.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹2.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 14th May 2026 Payment date: 22nd May 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.5%, which is about the same as the industry average. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (12% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (39% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 15% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 71% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹68.96 (up from ₹61.21 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹63.0b (up 19% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹25.1b (up 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 40% (down from 42% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 7.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 7.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 9% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts have reset their price target on Oberoi Realty from ₹2,200.67 to ₹2,094. This reflects updated views on slightly lower fair value, a modestly adjusted discount rate, and revised assumptions for revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E.

news.title: OBEROIRLTY: Revised Margin Outlook And Debenture Redemption Plans Will Shape Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Oberoi Realty to ₹1,756.62 from ₹1,795.88 as they factor in revised revenue growth assumptions, a slightly higher discount rate, and an updated future P/E outlook, partly offset by a stronger profit margin view. Analyst Commentary Bullish Takeaways Bullish analysts point to the higher profit margin assumptions as a key support for the updated fair value, suggesting that improved cost discipline and mix can help offset a more conservative revenue view.

news.title: OBEROIRLTY: Efficient Margins And Project Execution Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have made a slight trim to the Oberoi Realty price target to about ₹2,200, reflecting updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples, while still seeing the stock supported by more efficient profitability expectations. Analyst Commentary Even with a slightly lower price target around ₹2,200, bullish analysts see room for Oberoi Realty to execute on its current project pipeline and support valuations that are linked to more efficient profitability assumptions.

news.title: Third quarter dividend of ₹2.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹2.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 23rd January 2026 Payment date: 5th February 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.5%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.4%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (13% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (33% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 15% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 55% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.12 (up from ₹17.01 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹14.9b (up 5.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹6.23b (flat on 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 42% (down from 44% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 15%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 23%. Revenue is forecast to grow 26% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 24% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 23% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Oberoi Realty Limited Declares Third Interim Dividend for the Fiscal Year 2025-2026, Payable on or Before February 5, 2026
news.body: The board of directors of Oberoi Realty Limited at its meeting held on January 19, 2026, has declared 3rd interim dividend for FY25-26 at the rate of INR 2/- (Rupees Two only) per equity share i.e. 20% of the face value of equity shares of INR 10/- each. Further, January 23, 2026 shall be the record date for the purpose of payment of the said interim dividend and the said interim dividend shall be paid starting on or before February 5, 2026.
